tables.label: g_abCompressedRwImage
tables.purpose: ARM Compiler compressed .data image. Scatterload record {src=0x10009810, dest=0x2000243C, size=0x404, handler=0x1000584E} at 0x100073B0 is walked by RunScatterLoadInitTable. Handler is nibble RLE (low nibble literals, high nibble zero-fill); 123 source bytes expand to 1028 SRAM bytes. After expand: VADC/SHS cal object at 0x200024B4 (ushort 0x1770 plus SHS0 0x480340E0/0x480340E4), hall-sector PWM uint16 maps used by ApplyHallSectorPwmPattern at 0x200024DC (fwd) and 0x200024E8 (rev), hall-state remap used by LookupHallCommutationAngle at 0x2000250A. Ride PAS/speed/wheel cells in this SRAM span start at 0 and are written later by InitializeRideDefaults. Not a sine LUT, wheel-mm LUT, or UART string table.

tables.label: g_abFlashRideNvmPage
tables.purpose: Ride NVM flash page. RunRideControlLoop loads r0=0x1000F000 and calls CopyBytesFromSourcePointer, which copies 255 bytes into SRAM 0x2000296C and stores the source cursor at ride-state+0x34. The next instruction compares dest[0] to 0xA9; stock image is erased 0xFF so the magic fails and RAM defaults remain. No other flash pointer into 0x1000F000-0x10010FFF exists. Remainder of this 4 KB (0x1000F100-0x10010FFF) is erased and unreferenced.

Erased 0xFF gap through 0x1000EFFF. Scatterload record at 0x100073C0 is ZEROINIT of SRAM 0x20002840 size 0x9D0 via handler 0x1000108C; the listed src address is unused. No strings, no LUTs, no code pointers. Auto-created DAT_10009a10/DAT_10009ba8 in this hole were 0xFF with only intra-data fake xrefs and were not named.

not_in_range.sine_foc_angle_table: Q15 sine / hall-angle words live in the midflash .data load image (e.g. literal 0x1000722C used by LookupHallCommutationAngle), not after 0x10009810.
not_in_range.wheel_size_mm_table: UpdateWheelSpeedPeriod computes period from wheel-size code 6-34 and a scale literal; no circumference LUT in this tail.
not_in_range.uart_strings: list_strings total=0 for the whole program; no ASCII protocol strings in 0x10009810+.
not_in_range.assist_percent_maps: PAS percents 30/50/70/85/100 are immediates in ApplyAssistLevelTargets, not flash tables here.
